title: Reverse Linked List
description:
Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the new head.

Example 1:
Input: head = [1,2,3,4,5]
Output: [5,4,3,2,1]

Example 2:
Input: head = [1,2]
Output: [2,1]

Example 3:
Input: head = []
Output: []

Constraints:
- 0 ≤ number of nodes ≤ 5000
- -5000 ≤ Node.val ≤ 5000
idea: Walk the list and re-point the links: remember the next node, point curr.Next to prev, then move prev and curr one step forward. When curr becomes nil, prev is the new head.
